svg.title: Braking Ring: catching the Ice Train
svg.desc: Left, to scale, seen from the north: Venus and the Ring 400 km up. Bricks come from behind Venus at 15.1 km/s on average, half aimed past each side, and Venus's gravity bends them onto the Ring's height at 18.2 km/s, eastbound on one side, westbound on the other. Right, a side view along the Ring: a catch, the parking belt and a tether lift.
